hero.title:
Community-Driven
Spring Restoration
hero.subtitle: Join the grassroots movement to protect and restore Indonesia's precious artesian springs. Monitor, restore, and preserve our water sources for future generations.
dashboard.title: Real-Time Impact
dashboard.description: Track our collective impact across Indonesia.
map.title: Interactive Spring
map.description: Explore springs across Indonesia. View their current status, community reports, and contribute your own observations.
map.protectionBanner: Source protection: public spring locations are snapped to a {radius} km grid — every spring within that radius shares the same coordinate. Field leads and admins see precise locations after sign-in.
map.reportDescription: Lightweight, mobile-friendly forms hosted by SpringHub. No app install needed — they work in your browser.
map.discoveryPrompt: Spotted a spring not on the map? Add it via Spring Monitoring.
form.desc.monitoring: Log a spring's current condition — flow, water quality, cleanliness, and a geo-tagged photo.
form.desc.restoration: Report a restoration activity — what was done, before/after photos, volunteer turnout, and any measurements taken.
form.desc.trench: Log infiltration trenches you've dug. These help groundwater recharge in the spring's catchment area.
form.desc.planting: Log endemic / native trees you've planted around a spring or its recharge area.
form.desc.seedling: Update SpringHub on the seedlings available at your nursery, so we can match them with planting projects.
form.success.title: Report Submitted!

volunteer.title: Volunteer
volunteer.description: Join thousands of environmental heroes making a difference across Indonesia. Earn points, and unlock eligibility to submit your own spring restoration project once you reach {threshold} pts.
volunteer.projectIdeaTitle: Have a Project Idea? Let's Make It Happen!
volunteer.projectIdeaDesc: Spring restoration, endemic tree planting, infiltration trenches, monitoring expeditions — share your initiative with the community. Proposals are reviewed by our admin team before publishing.
learn.title: Learning
learn.description: Expand your knowledge with our courses on spring conservation, tree planting, and traditional water wisdom.
media.title: Latest
media.description: Events, publications, and press from Jaga Semesta and SpringHub.
donate.title: Support
donate.description: Donations are processed through Xendit (cards, virtual accounts, e-wallets, QRIS). Every rupiah is tied to a measurable output reported by our field volunteers — and only admin-verified projects are open for funding.
donate.partnerDesc: We work with corporates, foundations, government bodies and community networks. Sponsor a region, fund a project type, or co-design a volunteer programme with us — outputs and locations are reported through verified field forms.
donate.invoiceDetail: Invoice #{id} for Rp {amount} has been created. Status: Pending.
donate.dummyMode: (Dummy mode — payment is simulated. Check admin panel.)
